faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: What people ask before trying it. No sign-up needed — scroll up and try it yourself.

items.a: Tap the mic and speak — your voice is transcribed and translated in a few seconds, shown as text and available to hear read aloud. No typing needed.
186 languages. Pick your own language once, then start a conversation thread with anyone else's.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: No. Try it right on this page with no sign-up. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of just this browser.
Yes, one history per language pair — even without signing in, your browser is remembered. Clear a pair's history anytime from the trash button above the chat.

items.q: Can I use text instead of voice?
items.a: Yes. Switch to keyboard mode anytime and type your message instead of speaking.

items.q: Does it work for two-way conversation?
items.a: Yes. Tap or swipe a translated line to flip between the original and the translation, so both sides can follow along on one screen.

translator.micBlockedDesc: You've blocked microphone access, so voice input can't work. Voice input needs the microphone to record your speech.
translator.micBlockedHow: To turn it back on: click the lock / site icon in the address bar, switch Microphone to Allow, then reload the page. On Safari: Preferences → Websites → Microphone → Allow. On iPhone/iPad: Settings → Safari → Microphone → Allow.
translator.micNotFound: No microphone found — check that it's connected and switched on, then try again.
translator.micBusy: The microphone is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
translator.micInsecure: Voice input only works over a secure https:// connection. Open the site via https:// and try again.
translator.micGeneric: Couldn't start the microphone. Try again.
